name: Agilent Technologies
outlook:
What Agilent Technologies says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenue and EPSFourth-quarter 2026 revenue is expected in the range of $1.98 billion to $2.0 billion, growth of 6.4% to 7.4% reported and up 5.2% to 6.2% core (1)(5) . Non-GAAP EPS (4) is expected in the range of $1.71 to $1.74 per share.
  • Fiscal year 2026: revenueFiscal year 2026 revenue is now expected in the range of $7.49 billion to $7.51 billion, representing a range of up 7.8% to 8.1% reported and up 5.8% to 6.0% core, (1)(5) an increase of 65 basis points at the midpoint.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 26, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
